## Objective and scope

Deliver a reproducible, maintainable T1-to-T1 brain registration method with competitive anatomical accuracy, reliable completion, and explicit numerical geometry guarantees. This is the executable epic requested by the user on 2026-10-14, derived from the six-stage plan in this conversation. Scope is acquired structural brain MRI and the current FlashAlign supplied-affine handoff. Clinical deployment, multimodal qualification, learned features, GPU specialization, universal diffeomorphism claims, and an unconditional architectural rewrite are outside this epic.

Evidence motivating the work: the selected HalfFlow recipe reaches mean bidirectional Dice 0.419023 and mean bidirectional median-label HD95 5.223381 mm on five observed development pairs; same-affine ANTs SyNOnly reaches 0.487617 and 4.924949 mm. ANTs geometry has not been independently audited and runtime/schedules are not matched. The latest seven development fits complete fine refinement with valid numerical geometry but the tested recipes lose anatomical quality and were rejected. CC reweighting is a diagnostic hypothesis, not an established defect.

Proposed qualification targets carried from the agreed plan: at least 100 predeclared directed pairs, at least 60 distinct subjects, at least three independently sourced cohorts; at least 95% complete accepted nonlinear results with all attempts in the denominator; noninferiority to audited same-affine SyN within 0.02 mean Dice and 5% HD95, with subject-aware uncertainty. Every returned result must satisfy existing coverage, cell-topology and composed-map inverse contracts. P01 freezes exact aggregation, confidence rules, tail/cohort criteria, failure scoring, and resource limits before new qualification results. These are proposed engineering criteria, not achieved results or community standards. Do not lower them after seeing qualification outcomes.

Existing ledger floor remains binding: at least 20 pairs/two independent datasets, at least 90% convergence, zero sampled folded cells over the complete declared evaluation region, coverage at least 0.99, minimum sampled cell Jacobian at least 0.05, recorded bidirectional inverse limits and aggregate improvement over affine. The stronger epic target supplements that floor. Preserve the current 0.2 mm/0.2 voxel inverse checks wherever applicable; pin exact regions and thresholds rather than conflating residual, endpoint and boundary checks.

First implementation tranche: P01/P02 fair reference and protocol, D01-D03 checkpoint diagnosis, then O01 coherent regularized baseline. P03 reserves independent data early. Existing R01 and R02 remain the owners of refinement-quality and full-boundary inverse work; their histories and existing parents are preserved.

## Acceptance criteria

1. All six milestones pass their own gates, with reproducible receipts and all failed/excluded cases accounted for. Closing an experiment with a negative result cannot pass an outcome gate.
2. Frozen independent qualification meets the declared accuracy, reliability, geometry, cohort/tail and practical-runtime criteria. Any failed qualification becomes observed development data; a changed method requires fresh confirmation.
3. One versioned parameter policy and exact implementation are delivered with typed termination, bounded work, diagnostics, source/input/config hashes, replay commands and platform evidence.
4. Update the capability ledger and reconcile overlapping historical HalfFlow records only from verified evidence. Numerical sampled topology does not imply continuous invertibility or SmoothIso.
5. This planning operation creates open, unassigned work. It does not claim implementation completion, authorize data leakage, change production defaults, or publish a release.

  - HFQ-P03: Reserve independent cohorts and prevent subject leakage (`bd-01M4X4DY1X3MNMZC5J99F9GPSP`)
- HFQ-G2: Explain fine-refinement anatomical regressions (`bd-01M4X4DWSY1K2SE753J466X0ZG`)
  - HFQ-D01: Capture real-image refinement trajectories and anatomical changes (`bd-01M4X4DY7DQCVK33MCK3T17NA1`)
  - HFQ-D02: Audit reweighting, real-image derivatives and pyramid consistency (`bd-01M4X4DYCNRG58VQVKJKH77WWR`)

- HFQ-G3: Admit a coherent regularized optimization baseline (`bd-01M4X4DWZGYGS728AQ5R0G67Z4`)
  - HFQ-O01: Implement an explicit regularized objective and consistent acceptance (`bd-01M4X4DYQT456CQJT20F7633HN`)
  - HFQ-O02: Compare optimizer updates and add meaningful stopping (`bd-01M4X4DYXGZ20K04QQM34N1VEZ`)
  - Reused R02: full export-boundary inverse contract (`bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE`)
- HFQ-G4: Select a demonstrably better anatomical refinement policy (`bd-01M4X4DX5Q6MBZCYTY4RQ85AHN`)
  - HFQ-A01: Test targeted anatomical objectives and scale-dependent flexibility (`bd-01M4X4DZ2RBKVMK1H8MEPYGW0B`)
  - HFQ-A02: Select one deterministic policy on subject-separated development data (`bd-01M4X4DZ8108PWD4HZCYZ6MKT8`)
  - Reused R01: larger/refined updates with anatomical and geometry acceptance (`bd-01M4NVC83PEY6F4GSGDRD6RFBH`)
- HFQ-G5: Pass frozen independent multi-cohort qualification (`bd-01M4X4DXBQBXM8X5TYD157REDD`)
  - HFQ-Q01: Stress the selected policy within its declared operating range (`bd-01M4X4DZE4QYGX3RZSQ2T945DA`)
  - HFQ-Q02: Freeze the final executable and sealed qualification protocol (`bd-01M4X4DZM817WNYDR9Z2EVKXEG`)
  - HFQ-Q03: Run sealed multi-cohort HalfFlow and SyN qualification (`bd-01M4X4DZSH4T8JPYC8MQQ1HAXZ`)
  - HFQ-Q04: Independently reproduce and adjudicate qualification (`bd-01M4X4DZYZD9WN8PX3N2MMSWKF`)
- HFQ-G6: Deliver the maintainable qualified method (`bd-01M4X4DXH501X2F7757YMER8RJ`)
  - HFQ-U01: Deliver bounded execution, diagnostics and a reproducible API/CLI (`bd-01M4X4E04RDJ3NBEVA2ZNGSP6X`)
  - HFQ-U02: Profile and bound runtime, allocation and peak memory (`bd-01M4X4E0ADEA2KGZSVWDWZGG8C`)
  - HFQ-U03: Admit the qualified revision and reconcile historical HalfFlow work (`bd-01M4X4E0FS0SVB8FKC5N1J108V`)

Containment is non-blocking. Explicit dependency edges carry execution order and milestone closure. U01/U02 sit under delivery but precede the final Q02 candidate freeze; G6 itself follows G5. No release gate is satisfied by a completed negative experiment.


## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
